up: Provide the exact activity values and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in the assay with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1614280. Exact activity values are those where the standard_relation is '=' and the standard_value is not null. For each qualifying record, return the following columns: molecule_chembl_id (the ChEMBL ID of the compound), canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, pchembl_value (if available), and the assay_chembl_id (CHEMBL1614280). Join activities to assays on assay_id, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter to assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614280', activities.standard_relation = '=', and activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL. Do not add any other filters.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.pchembl_value, ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614280' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
